sources.citation: WALS Online (local CLDF copy); StressTyp2 (local 2015 SQL dump); AUTOTYP WordDomains (local).

sources.citation: Thebe, Basanti. 2016. A Comparative Study of Negation and Interrogation between Yamphu and English Language. M.Ed. thesis, Tribhuvan University.
sources.note: Nothing on word stress (only 'rising tone' for yes/no questions).

sources.citation: Rai, Tara Bir. 2012. Yamphu and English Pronominals. M.Ed. thesis, Tribhuvan University, Kathmandu.
sources.note: p. 9 says Yamphu dialects differ 'in phonology, vocabulary and supra-segmental features level viz. tone, juncture, stress etc.'; Appendix D 'Yamphu Sound Systems' gives vowel/consonant charts only. No rule for stress placement.

sources.citation: Doornenbal, Marius. 2009. A grammar of Bantawa. Utrecht: LOT.
sources.note: Cites Rutgers 1998 for Yamphu morphology (negation, vector verbs) only; nothing on Yamphu stress.

sources.note: Nothing on stress; background chapter quotes Rutgers 1998 on dialects only.
